content.text:
I added `GET /api/crisis-contact` in `src/app/api/crisis-contact/route.ts`. It looks up the on-call practitioner in the patient's own practice and returns only `{name, phone}`. It returns 404 if nobody is on call, 403 for non-patients and 401 when unauthenticated. Each successful call writes an audit entry (`crisis_contact.read`, target `pr_…`) and a log line `crisis contact served` with no fields. `npm run verify` passes.

I used a new narrow repo query (`getOnCallCrisisContact`) that selects only `id`, `full_name` and `phone`, instead of the `SELECT *` helper. The audit entry holds only the practitioner id, not the patient's. New tests in `tests/crisis-contact.test.ts` cover the response shape, audit row, log contents and the role checks. They also check that a Fernside patient (June) never gets Rosa's details.
